edge.diagnosis: all 18 diffs are arg_out_flit (15 bits) in cycles 2128-2145 after the WARM reset only; cold reset clean. Every diff cycle has arg_out_v=0 or arg_fault=1 in BOTH versions (diag log lockstep_edge_diag_valid_fault.log). Cause: ot_hgi_coll_argmax_static out_flit and ot_hgi_coll_amerge datapath are non-reset registers; in the reset-assert cycle legacy async flops clear before the posedge while sync flops clear at it, so a non-reset register captures a different stale value. Result is disqualified by the sticky fault / not valid, so no functional difference observed, but this random bench cannot sign it off.

realistic_schedule.dontcare_proof: diffs only on arg_out_flit while arg_out_v=0 in both: out_flit<=raw_flit every cycle and raw_flit carries amerge acci (non-reset, loaded only when s3v=1 and better()). The async-vs-sync assert cycle lets a different in-flight s3 value land in acci; accv is reset in both, so the first valid lane after start reloads acci (better(av,..,bv=0)=av). A legal schedule delivers >=1 lane before flush (cfg_g>=1, observed==g at flush, else fault), and publish is flush+6 after the last acc update (flush+4), so every published flit depends only on lanes since start. Consumer ot_hgi_coll_qslots_capture_pin_v2 samples src_d only on its compiled capture_slot and faults on src_v!=capture_slot.
